In Switzerland, the universal emergency number for all urgent situations — including medical emergencies, fire, police, and rescue services — is **112**.  

When calling **112**, you will be connected to an emergency dispatch center where you can describe your situation in detail. If a helicopter rescue is required and would reach the victim faster than ground-based services, the operators will coordinate with Rega (the Swiss Air-Rescue Guard), which is integrated into the emergency response system.  

So, even if a helicopter is the fastest option, you should still call **112** to alert the emergency services and ensure the appropriate rescue is activated.
